name: Ibufenac

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1968 — for liver harm

similar.name: Ibuprofen
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for stomach and gut problems, nerve and brain harm and heart harm

similar.name: Amphetamine

summary: Ibufenac was pulled from the market in the United Kingdom in 1968 due to liver harm [3]. In results from a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received low risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M]. Drugs that share similarities with Ibufenac carry strong boxed warnings in the United States for issues such as stomach, gut, nerve, brain, and heart harm [4], heart harm and addiction [5], or immune system and blood problems [6].
